test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks below will complete the letter series.

S_ P_ _G_IS G_I_ _PI
solution:
Given: S_ P_ _G_IS G_I_ _PI

By checking options:

1) GISPPSG → S__**G**__ P **__I__** __**S**__G__**P**__IS G__**P**__I__**S**__ __**G**__PI → (It follows the pattern of: SGPI - SGPI - SGPI - SGPI)

2) SISSSPG → S__S__ P __I__ __S__G__S__IS G__S__I__P__ __G__PI → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

3) GIPSSPG → S__G__ P __I__ __P__G__S__IS G__S__I__P__ __G__PI → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

4) SISPSPG → S__S__ P __I__ __S__G__P__IS G__S__I__P__ __G__PI → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

So, out of all the options "Option 1" follows the pattern.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
